name: list_frequently_asked_questions
description: The chatbot indicates the availability of frequently asked questions related to the CAU.

name: provide_service_catalog_and_contact_info
description: Offers users access to the service catalog of the Centro de Atención a Usuarios along with contact details, operating hours, and links to frequently asked questions.

outputs.description: Email contact for Centro de Atención a Usuarios at cau@uam.es for inquiries.
Phone contact at 914974029 for Centro de Atención a Usuarios inquiries.
Physical address at Escuela Politécnica Superior, Edificio B, Calle Francisco Tomás y Valiente n° 11, Campus Cantoblanco, 28049 Madrid for in-person contact.
Regular operating hours from Monday to Friday, 9:00h to 17:30h (excluding holidays) and reduced hours from Monday to Friday, 9:00h to 14:00h during non-working periods.
Consult the CATÁLOGO DE SERVICIOS OFRECIDOS, including the link to the catalog of IT services.
Link to frequently asked questions (preguntas frecuentes) regarding Centro de Atención a Usuarios.

name: provide_student_support_service_info
description: Provides information about available student counseling and support services offered at the university, including the Centro de Psicología Aplicada and other related units.

outputs.description: Information about the Centro de Psicología Aplicada (CPA) and associated services, including details on student support and consultations.

name: prompt_for_password_change
description: Provides step-by-step instructions for changing the password, including obtaining an activation code if necessary.

name: prompt_for_first_time_password_setup
description: Guides the user through the process of establishing their password for the first time, including necessary steps and requirements.

name: provide_account_and_services_information
description: Offers comprehensive details about account setup options and integrated services within ID-UAM for students, staff, and external users.

outputs.description: Details the services available through ID-UAM, such as account creation and support options for new students and staff.

name: provide_information_on_virtual_platforms
description: Provides information about contacting the Oficina de Atención al Estudiante for inquiries related to virtual platforms and directs the user to relevant resources.

name: provide_university_information
description: Provides general information about the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, covering its commitment to student education and details on available programs and faculties.

outputs.description: An overview of the university's offerings, including degrees, programs available, and the university's commitment to student training.

name: present_options_for_future_students
description: Lists options and relevant links for future students considering the university.

outputs.description: Includes links for DÍA DE BIENVENIDA, Grados Universitarios, and Vida Universitaria.

name: provide_préstamo_info
description: Informs the user about the availability and process for borrowing laptops from the university libraries.

outputs.description: Details on where and how to access laptop loans.

name: provide_library_access_info
description: Provides information on accessing library resources and necessary user identification for accessing services.

outputs.description: Guidelines on accessing library resources remotely, including the requirement for VPN.

name: present_vpn_setup_options
description: Offers options and links for installing and configuring VPN for remote access to university services.

outputs.description: Lists different guides available for setting up VPN on various operating systems.

name: provide_vpn_installation_guide
description: Provides detailed instructions for installing and configuring the GlobalProtect VPN client based on the user's device operating system.

parameters.name: selected_os
parameters.description: Represents the operating system the user will use for VPN installation.

outputs.description: Links to specific installation guides for each operating system.

name: present_faculty_and_programs_overview
description: Presents an overview of the faculties and schools available at the university along with information on programs and degrees offered.

outputs.description: Overview of faculties and educational programs offered at the university.

name: provide_admission_and_registration_info
description: Informs the user about the registration process and directs them to the appropriate school's or faculty's official webpage for detailed information.

outputs.description: General information on the admission process and registration for programs.

name: guide_on_moodle_access
description: Informs the user about the need for an institutional account to access Moodle and outlines the different Moodle environments available.

outputs.description: Describes the different Moodle environments available, including Grado, Postgrado, and Formación.
